stelvio-umbrail-bormio-loop.title: Stelvio · Umbrail · Bormio Loop
stelvio-umbrail-bormio-loop.slogan: Two passes and 71 km, high point 2757 m
stelvio-umbrail-bormio-loop.story: The Stelvio is the one every rider names, and the numbered hairpins on the Prato side deserve it. Ride it early: by ten the cyclists, campers and coaches turn the top third into a slow-moving queue. The Umbrail descent into Switzerland is the reward - narrower, emptier and far better surfaced than its reputation.

waypoints.name: Bormio
waypoints.advice: Bormio is where the day begins. Reckon on about 2 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Stelvio Pass summit, climbing 1532 m.

waypoints.name: Stelvio Pass summit
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2757 m here. The road climbs 1532 m on the way up to it, steeply. Reckon on about 12 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Prato allo Stelvio, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Prato allo Stelvio
waypoints.advice: A break here. You lose 1842 m on the way down to it, steeply. Next is Trafoi, climbing 628 m.

waypoints.name: Trafoi
waypoints.advice: Trafoi, about halfway at 1543 m. The road climbs 628 m on the way up to it, hard. Reckon on about 4 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Santa Maria Val Müstair, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Santa Maria Val Müstair
waypoints.advice: Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Umbrail Pass, climbing 1126 m.

waypoints.name: Umbrail Pass
waypoints.advice: Umbrail Pass is the summit of this stretch at 2501 m. The road climbs 1126 m on the way up to it, steeply. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Back to Bormio, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Back to Bormio
waypoints.advice: Back to Bormio closes the day. You lose 1276 m on the way down to it, steeply.

stelvio-umbrail-bormio-loop.speedBand: Posted limits vary by country - read the signs, not the app

scenicChapters.title: Stelvio Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2757 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Stelvio Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 8.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter. First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

The stops in between: Hadrian's Wall and vallum in wall mile 66, Skinburness, Burrow Walls Roman fort and Ravenglass Roman fort bath-house. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
